checks.command: npm run check:structure && npm run check:boundaries

exit_criteria.evidence: Per-boundary opaque handles have no serializable fields and are rejected at prompt, evidence-artifact, log, export, and ordinary network payload boundaries; secret-free inspection produces a non-authoritative PASS record.

Branded decisions require operation-scoped canonical same-filesystem no-follow paths with root identity checks and exact canonical-origin egress with redirect reauthorization and sandbox-profile binding.

review.approval_scope: Exact S02 implementation hashes recorded in S02-C015 and fresh resolving checks S02-C016 through S02-C019; invalid on source or evidence drift.
review.assurance_limit: No separate agent or contract_reviewer performed a second technical audit; the independent decision is the user's external human approval over author-produced technical evidence.

open_risks: The external human approval is not a separate agent-authored technical audit and is valid only for the exact reviewed hashes and resolving evidence.
The primitive is not yet wired to every future provider, tool, hook, or effect adapter.
Process/container isolation, DNS rebinding defenses, atomic descriptor-relative filesystem effects, quotas, and effect receipts are outside S02 and remain unimplemented.
Raw-secret pattern checks are defense in depth and not exhaustive secret detection.
The private scaffold package has no declared public export map.
not_verified: End-to-end effect-time integration across future runtime call sites
T04 sandbox and external-tool adapter gate
